user.title: Choose your lights
user.description: Daylight follows the sun, with dim, warm nights and brighter, cooler days. Select lights to start with automatic seasonal timing. Adaptation switches start off; enable them when ready. Night/day levels are optional adjustments below.

data_description.min_color_temp_kelvin: Lower values are warmer. Each bulb uses its supported range.
data_description.max_color_temp_kelvin: Higher values are cooler. Each bulb uses its supported range.

data_description.transition: Maximum total fade for ongoing updates, capped by the hub update interval. With serialized native fades, this duration is divided equally between both phases. Turning on or resuming adaptation snaps instead. Subject to bulb support.
data_description.adapt_only_on_state_change: Skip periodic adaptation; still adapt when a light turns on or adaptation resumes.
data_description.separate_turn_on_commands: Send brightness and color temperature in separate commands.
data_description.send_split_delay: Delay, in seconds, between the brightness and color temperature commands.
data_description.serialized_native_fades: Periodic updates only. Splits the total capped fade equally into two non-overlapping native phases: temperature first, then brightness. Off by default; turn-on and resume snaps are unchanged.

error.page_invalid: Complete this setting to apply the page. To return instead, clear any invalid fields and select Return without changing this page. Earlier draft changes are kept.
error.time_required: Choose a local time to apply this page, or select Return without changing this page.

init.title: Shared daily schedule
init.description: This schedule applies to every target on this hub. Edit each target separately for its lights and night/day levels. Changes stay in a draft until you choose **Save changes**; cancel to discard them. [View the saved schedule](/daylight-preview); opening the preview leaves this form and does not show unsaved changes.

daily_timing.title: Daily timing
daily_timing.description: Choose what sets morning and evening timing. The next page shows only the controls for those choices. Individual transition overrides are edited under Advanced settings.

data_description.return_without_changes: To return, clear any invalid fields, select Return without changing this page, then Next. Earlier draft changes are kept.

daily_details.title: Set daily timing
daily_details.description: Sun offsets: negative minutes move timing earlier; positive minutes move it later. A fixed morning time anchors the **start of the brightness transition**; a fixed evening time anchors its **finish**. Clock times use Home Assistant's local timezone. Continue to keep these changes in the draft.

data.evening_next_day: Evening finishes on the following day

data_description.morning_offset_minutes: -720 to +720 minutes. Negative = before sunrise; positive = after sunrise. Shifts both morning tracks.
data_description.evening_offset_minutes: -720 to +720 minutes. Negative = before sunset; positive = after sunset. Shifts both evening tracks.
data_description.morning_time: Local time in Home Assistant's timezone.
data_description.evening_time: Local time in Home Assistant's timezone.
data_description.evening_next_day: Use the next calendar day for an evening finish after midnight.
data_description.return_without_changes: To return, clear any invalid fields, select Return without changing this page, then Next. Earlier draft changes are kept.

transitions.title: Transition duration and shape
transitions.description: Duration is a multiplier: **1 = standard, 0.5 = half as long, 2 = twice as long**. It affects morning and evening together for that track. Durations still stretch and shrink with daylight, and common transitions shorten when needed to fit. Smooth eases in and out; Linear changes at a constant rate. These control the daily curve, not an individual bulb's update fade.

data_description.return_without_changes: To return, clear any invalid fields, select Return without changing this page, then Next. Earlier draft changes are kept.

advanced.title: Advanced schedule settings
advanced.description: Common timing is calculated first. Each individual override then replaces only its selected transition endpoint; other endpoints keep their common timing. Changes here remain in the draft until Save changes.

endpoint.title: Individual transition times
endpoint.description: Choose one transition endpoint to edit. You can change several endpoints before saving; the complete schedule is checked only when you choose Save changes.

data_description.return_without_changes: To return, clear any invalid fields, select Return without changing this page, then Next. Earlier draft changes are kept.

endpoint_rule.title: Choose a timing rule
endpoint_rule.description: Use common timing removes this endpoint's override. Otherwise, the next page shows only the fields for the selected rule.

data_description.return_without_changes: To return, clear any invalid fields, select Return without changing this page, then Next. Earlier draft changes are kept.

endpoint_details.title: Set the individual transition time
endpoint_details.description: Clock times use Home Assistant's timezone. Solar offsets are signed: negative = before the reference, positive = after it. **Seasonal reference date: {date}**, captured when you opened these settings. Seasonal minutes are measured on that date (the next date if Following day is checked), then stretch with daylight in other seasons. Continue to keep this endpoint in the draft.

data.offset_minutes: Offset (minutes; seasonal uses the reference date)

data_description.time: Local time in Home Assistant's timezone.
data_description.next_day: Use the next calendar day's clock time or solar reference.
data_description.return_without_changes: To return, clear any invalid fields, select Return without changing this page, then Next. Earlier draft changes are kept.

runtime.title: Update interval
runtime.description: How often Daylight applies the current curve to enabled targets. This is independent of the daily transition duration and shape. Continue to keep the interval in the draft.

data_description.return_without_changes: To return, clear any invalid fields, select Return without changing this page, then Next. Earlier draft changes are kept.

reset.title: Reset timing defaults
reset.description: Confirmation resets common morning/evening timing, duration multipliers, and all individual endpoint overrides in this draft. It does **not** change transition shapes, update interval, or targets and their levels. Nothing is applied until Save changes. Leave unchecked to go back without resetting.

data.confirm: Reset common timing and individual overrides

data_description.return_without_changes: To return, clear any invalid fields, select Return without changing this page, then Next. Earlier draft changes are kept.

save_error.title: Schedule not saved
save_error.description:
The full-year check found a conflict: {detail}

Your draft is still here and saved settings have not changed. Choose a page below to repair it, then Save changes again. Cancel discards the draft.
